Name: BARBARA'S BAKERY
Tasting_Notes: Sweet Caramel, Cookie Crunch, Vanilla Malt Milkshake
Desc:
A Timeless Classic – Silky, Balanced & Refined

Name: CITRUS CIRCUS
Tasting_Notes: Citrus Circus A red honey
Desc:
Citrus Circus 
 A red honey processed coffee from Koraput, Odisha, roasted as a true omni roast for both filter and espresso. 
 Citrus Circus is playful but precise. Bright citrus sweetness meets jammy depth, balancing candy-like fruit with brown sugar warmth. It’s expressive without being loud, juicy without losing structure. 
 Taste Profile 
  Filter  Orange candy and raisin jam upfront, layered with brown sugar sweetness and mixed berries. Soft citrus peel rounds the cup, finishing clean, juicy, and gently sweet like citrus candy. 
  Espresso  Thick marmalade sweetness with a brown sugar body. Jammy fruit carries through the shot, supported by soft berry acidity and a smooth, lingering finish. 
 Brew Recipes 
  V60  
 Coffee: 15 g Water: 240 ml Ratio: 1:16 Temperature: 92–94°C Grind: Medium Brew Time: 2:30–3:00 
 Results in a bright, candy-like cup with layered sweetness and a clean citrus finish. 
  Espresso  
 Dose: 18 g Yield: 38–40 g Time: 28–32 seconds Ratio: ~1:2.1 
 Juicy marmalade body with soft acidity and a rounded, sugar-sweetig sweetness. 
 Details 
 Origin: Koraput, Odisha Varietal: 795 Process: Red Honey Roast: Medium Omni Brew: Filter & Espresso 
 Lively without chaos. Sweet without sharpness.  Citrus Circus  is controlled brightness, performed perfectly.

Name: COZY COOKIE
Tasting_Notes: Cozy Cookie A washed coffee from Yirgacheffe, Ethiopia
Desc:
Cozy Cookie  
 A washed coffee from Yirgacheffe, Ethiopia, roasted as a balanced omni roast for both filter and espresso. 
  Cozy Cookie  is warm, smooth, and comforting by design. Built around sweetness and body rather than acidity, it brings together cocoa, nuts, and soft vanilla notes in a cup that feels familiar and easy. It’s gentle without being boring, sweet without being heavy. 
 
  Taste Profile  
  Filter  
 Cocoa and roasted nuts lead the cup, followed by soft vanilla sweetness. The profile stays round and smooth with low acidity, finishing clean and cozy with a lingering chocolatey warmth. 
  Espresso  
 Caramel cookie sweetness with a chocolate-forward body. Thick, creamy, and dessert-like, supported by malted vanilla notes and a smooth, lingering finish. Especially good with milk. 
 
  Brew Recipes  
  V60  
 Coffee: 15 g Water: 240 ml Ratio: 1:16 Temperature: 92–94°C Grind: Medium Brew Time: 2:30–3:00 
 Results in a smooth, cocoa-driven cup with gentle sweetness and a calm, comforting finish. 
  Espresso  
 Dose: 18 g Yield: 38–40 g Time: 28–32 seconds Ratio: ~1:2.1 
 Creamy, chocolatey espresso with caramel cookie sweetness and a rounded mouthfeel. 
 
  Details  
 Origin: Yirgacheffe, Ethiopia Varietal: Mixed Heirloom Process: Washed Roast: Medium Omni Brew: Filter & Espresso

Name: CULTURED 42
Tasting_Notes: #04: CULTURED 42 Kerehaklu
Process: it’s a ritual. At BROOT, we craft each
Desc:
#04: CULTURED 42   
 Kerehaklu Estate • SLN9 • 42hr Anoxic Washed (Inoculated) 
 Producer : Mr. Pranoy Thipaiah 
 
 A washed coffee, redefined. 
 Cultured 42 is built on precision. 42 hours of controlled anoxic fermentation, guided through selective inoculation, transform a classic washed profile into something far more layered. 
 This is not a loud, over fermented cup. It’s clean, structured, and quietly expressive. 
 Expect a cup that opens with bright clarity, moves into a smooth, cultured sweetness, and finishes with a refined, lingering balance. 
 
   In the Cup   
  Filter  Green apple • lime zest • floral lift Silky body with pastry like sweetness and a clean, cultured finish 
  Espresso  Caramel • almond cream • citrus peel Rounded acidity with a smooth, dessert like finish 
 
   Why You’ll Love It   
 • A modern take on washed coffee with added depth • Clean, bright, and highly drinkable • Balanced acidity with a smooth, creamy body • Built for filter, versatile enough for espresso • Limited release. Once it’s gone, it’s gone 
 
   Coffee Details   
 Origin Kerehaklu Estate, India Varietal SLN9 Process 42hr Anoxic Washed, Inoculated Fermentation Roast Level Light, filter focused 
 
   Brew Guide   
  Pour Over recommended  15g coffee to 250ml water Brew time 2:30 to 3:00 
  French Press  18g coffee to 300ml water Brew time 4:00 
 
   From the Drop Series   
 Part of our ongoing drop system. Small lots, released with intent. No repeats. No mass production. Just coffee worth paying attention to.

Name: DARK HONEY
Tasting_Notes: Honeyed Apricot, Dried Figs, Wildflower Nectar
Desc:
Chikmagalur, KA | SLN 795 | Dark Honey Process | 100% Arabica  
 This one’s for those who chase depth. 
 Sourced from the lush slopes of Unnaki Estate, this Arabica is processed using the Dark Honey method where part of the mucilage is left intact during drying, letting natural sugars soak into the bean. What you get is a cup bursting with golden complexity. 
 Think: honeyed apricot, dried figs, and a soft wildflower nectar finish. 
 Roasted medium to keep the balance between fruit and body. Smooth acidity, full texture, and a lingering sweetness that doesn’t quit. 
  Tasting Notes:  Honeyed Apricot · Dried Figs · Wildflower Nectar 
  Elevation:  4000–4700 FT  Process:  Dark Honey  Roast Level:  Medium  Varietal:  SLN 795

Name: DARK MATTER
Tasting_Notes: Most coffee is overhyped and underdelive
Desc:
Most coffee is overhyped and underdelivers. 
 Too acidic. Too inconsistent. Too much talk. 
  Dark Matter fixes that.  
 Roasted deeper for strength, body, and reliability — this is coffee that hits the same way, every single day. No surprises. No adjustments. Just a solid, satisfying cup that works whether you drink it black or with milk. 
 
   Taste Profile   
   Filter   
 Heavy, low-acid cup with dominant dark cocoa and roasted nuts. Clean bitterness, subtle caramelized sweetness, and a steady, no-nonsense finish. 
 
   Espresso   
 Bold and syrupy with thick body. Dark chocolate leads, backed by roasted nuts and a slight burnt sugar edge. Strong, punchy, and built to cut through milk without disappearing. 
 
   Why This Works   
 
 Built for  daily drinking , not occasional tasting 
 
 Low acidity  — easy on the stomach 
 
 Consistent every brew  — no guesswork 
 Strong enough for milk, clean enough for black 
 
 This is the coffee you don’t think about. You just reach for it. 
 
   Brew Recipes   
   V60   
 Coffee: 15 g Water: 240 ml Ratio: 1:16 Temperature: 93–95°C Grind: Medium Brew Time: 2:30–3:00 
 Strong, cocoa-heavy cup with low acidity and a clean finish. 
 
   Espresso   
 Dose: 18 g Yield: 36–40 g Time: 28–32 seconds Ratio: ~1:2 
 Thick, chocolate-forward espresso with high body and long finish. 
 
   Details   
 Origin: India Varietal: Blend Process: Multi-Process Roast: Vienna (Medium-Dark) Brew: Filter & Espresso 
 
 If your coffee needs too much effort to taste good, it’s not good coffee. 
  Dark Matter is built to work.

Name: DRIFTWOOD
Tasting_Notes: DRIFTWOOD Medium
Process: it’s a ritual. At BROOT, we craft each
Desc:
DRIFTWOOD 
 Medium Roast Monsoon Malabar 
 There’s something strangely comforting about Monsoon Malabar. 
 Maybe it’s the way the coffee changes with time. Maybe it’s the sea air. Or maybe it’s because no other coffee tastes this unmistakably Indian. 
 DRIFTWOOD is our medium roast take on the classic Monsoon Malabar profile. Instead of pushing it too dark, we roasted it slower and lighter to preserve its dense body while bringing out more sweetness, texture, and clarity in the cup. 
 The result is low in acidity, syrupy, woody, slightly spiced, and incredibly smooth. 
 Expect notes of cocoa nibs, toasted nuts, old cedar wood, and mellow raisin sweetness layered over that iconic monsooned depth. 
 This is the kind of coffee that feels best during slow evenings, rain outside the window, or the first quiet cup of the day. 
 Heavy body. Soft bitterness. Long comforting finish. 
 
 Taste Profile 
 Filter 
 Cocoa nibs • toasted nuts • wet wood 
 Espresso 
 Dark chocolate • raisin • tobacco sweetness 
 
 Origin 
  Region  Chikkamagalur, Karnataka 
  Elevation  1200 MSL 
  Variety  SLN 795 
  Process  Traditional Monsooning 
 
 Roast Level 
 Medium Roast 
 Built to retain the signature body of Monsoon Malabar while opening up a smoother and sweeter side of the coffee. 
 
 Best Brewed As 
 
 
 Espresso 
 
 
 Moka Pot 
 
 
 French Press 
 
 
 AeroPress 
 
 
 Milk-based drinks 
 
 
 
 Brew Guide 
 Pour Over 
 18g coffee 300g water 93°C 2:45–3:00 mins 
 Espresso 
 18g in 38–40g out 28–32 sec 
 
 What Monsooning Does 
 During monsooning, the beans are exposed to humid monsoon winds along India’s western coast for weeks. The coffee swells in size, loses acidity, deepens in body, and develops the earthy, mellow character that made Monsoon Malabar famous around the world. 
 DRIFTWOOD keeps that heritage intact, just with a cleaner and more modern roast approach.

Tasting_Notes: Warm Cocoa • Brown Sugar • A Familiar Finish A balanced, full-bodied espresso blend designed for everyday comfort
Process: it’s a ritual. At BROOT, we craft each
Desc:
Warm Cocoa • Brown Sugar • A Familiar Finish A balanced, full-bodied espresso blend designed for everyday comfort. 
 House No. 02 is the second release in our House Series — a lineup of coffees built around routine, consistency, and quiet familiarity. 
 Built on a washed base from Chikamagalur, layered with arabica cherry for body, and finished with a touch of natural sweetness from Kaimara, this blend is smooth, rounded, and deeply satisfying. 
 Expect a cup that leans into warmth soft cocoa notes, gentle brown sugar sweetness, and a full, comforting body that holds beautifully across brew styles. It’s easy to drink, easy to dial in, and hard to replace once you get used to it. 
 Designed for everyday use, House No. 02 performs just as well with milk as it does black. Whether it’s your morning espresso or an evening cup, this is the kind of coffee you reach for without thinking. 
 
  The House Series  
 House No. 02 continues our House Series, coffees designed to be part of your everyday. 
 Every fourth drop introduces a new House blend. Not one-offs, but evolving expressions of what a daily coffee can be. 
 House No. 01 set the foundation. House No. 02 builds on it, fuller, smoother, more refined. 
 With House No. 03, 04 and beyond, the idea remains the same: different expressions, same purpose. 
 Built to stay. Refined over time. 
 
  Why you’ll love it  
 • Smooth, full-bodied cup with low to medium acidity • Warm cocoa profile with a soft, natural sweetness • Excellent crema and texture for espresso • Works beautifully with milk and black brews • Balanced and easy to dial in across methods 
 
  Brew Guide  
 Works best for: 
 Espresso Moka Pot French Press South Indian Filter Manual Pour Over (for a fuller, richer cup) 
 
  Roast Level  
 Medium to Medium Dark Roast 
 
  Who is this for?  
 If you enjoy balanced coffees with a warm, chocolate-forward profile and a smooth, comforting finish—House No. 02 is built for your everyday. 
 
  Freshly Roasted  
 Roasted in small batches at our Delhi roastery and shipped fresh. 
 
  Some coffees come and go. This one stays.

Desc:
Jam Jar

 Jam Jar is rich, composed, and fruit-forward. Built around depth rather than brightness, it delivers syrupy sweetness with a clean, elegant finish.

 Water: 240 ml 
 
 
 Ratio: 1:16

 Brew Time: 2:30–3:00

  Espresso

 Time: 28–32 seconds 
 
 
 Ratio: ~1:2.2 
 
 
 Thick body, syrupy sweetness, jammy fruit upfront with a polished finish. 
 Details 
 
 
  Origin:  Lam Dong, Vietnam 
 
 
  Varietal:  Typica 
 
 
  Process:  Natural 
 
 
  Roast:  Medium 
 
 
  Brew:  Filter & Espresso

 MALTLINE tastes like someone accidentally left a pint of craft beer beside a brew bar and discovered something special. 
 Produced at Kaapikaadu Estate, this lot underwent a Kölsch beer fermentation before drying, creating a cup that blurs the line between specialty coffee and brewing culture. The result isn't beer-flavoured coffee. It's coffee with an entirely different kind of sweetness, structure and complexity. 
 Expect layers of malted biscuit, golden raisin and dark honey on filter. Pull it as espresso and it transforms into notes of toffee, stout cacao and brown sugar, wrapped in a syrupy body with remarkably low bitterness. 
 This is the second release in our experimental robusta series and one of the most unusual coffees we've roasted to date. 
 If you've never enjoyed robusta before, start here. 
 
 IN THE CUP 
  Filter  Malted Biscuit • Golden Raisin • Dark Honey 
  Espresso  Toffee • Stout Cacao • Brown Sugar 
 
 WHY IT'S DIFFERENT 
 Most robustas are selected for caffeine and body. 
 This one was selected for flavour. 
 The Kölsch beer fermentation introduces a deeper sweetness and a rounded, malt-like character while preserving the heavy mouthfeel robusta is known for. The cup is rich, comforting and surprisingly refined, with almost no harshness and a long lingering finish. Fermentation, processing and roast all shape the final flavour experience in specialty coffee.

Name: MIDNIGHT EQUATOR
Tasting_Notes: Midnight Equator A carbonic maceration natural from Uganda
Desc:
Midnight Equator 
 A carbonic maceration natural from Uganda, roasted medium to medium-light as a true omni roast. 
 Midnight Equator is precise fermentation done right. The sealed-tank process intensifies fruit clarity while preserving structure, giving the cup layered sweetness without chaos. 
 Dark fruit leads. Cocoa grounds it. The finish lingers long and composed. 
 This is Uganda with control. 
 
 Taste Profile 
  Filter  Black cherry and plum upfront, followed by pomegranate brightness and caramelized sugar sweetness. Cocoa nib undertones add depth, finishing clean, silky, and gently wine-like. 
  Espresso  Dense dark chocolate body with stewed berry sweetness. Brown sugar richness supports a rounded acidity and a smooth, lingering finish. 
 
 Brew Recipes 
 V60 
 
 
 Coffee: 15 g 
 
 
 Water: 240 ml 
 
 
 Ratio: 1:16 
 
 
 Temperature: 92–94°C 
 
 
 Grind: Medium 
 
 
 Brew Time: 2:30–3:00 
 
 
 Results in a layered, fruit-driven cup with cocoa depth and refined sweetness. 
 Espresso 
 
 
 Dose: 18 g 
 
 
 Yield: 38–42 g 
 
 
 Time: 28–32 seconds 
 
 
 Ratio: ~1:2.1 
 
 
 Thick chocolate body, structured fruit sweetness, long clean finish. 
 
 Details 
 
 
 Origin: Uganda 
 
 
 Process: Carbonic Maceration 
 
 
 Roast: Medium Omni 
 
 
 Brew For: Filter & Espresso 
 
 
 Fermented in control. Roasted for clarity. Built for depth

Name: MOJITO
Tasting_Notes: This lot from Melkodige
Process: it’s a ritual. At BROOT, we craft each
Desc:
This lot from Melkodige Estate is our kind of experiment done right. Ripe SL9 cherries were hand-picked, floated to remove lights, then submerged with EM5 microbes for a 74-hour anaerobic ferment. After that, the cherries were moved to raised wooden trays and dried under shade for 15 days. 
 What this really means is flavor with layers: cocoa and raisin at the core, a lift of sweet lime, and a finish that hints at cacao nib and dried dates. It’s juicy without getting wild, sweet without tasting candy-like. 
 We roast this medium-light to keep the lime sparkle and retain the chocolatey depth that makes the cup feel complete. If you’re into expressive naturals that still behave well on brew bar, this is the one. 
 Taste 
 Cocoa, raisin, sweet lime, cacao nib, dried dates. 
 Brew guide 
 
 
 Filter: 1:16, 92–94°C, 2:45–3:00 total (V60/Kalita/AeroPress). 
 
 
 Light espresso: 1:2.3 in 30–34s; expect a syrupy shot with citrus pop. 
 
 
 Specs 
 
 
 Estate: Melkodige Estate, Chikmagalur, KA 
 
 
 Variety: SL9 
 
 
 Process: EM5 anaerobic natural (74-hour submerged ferment) 
 
 
 Drying: 15 days on raised, shaded beds 
 
 
 Elevation: 4200 ft MSL 
 
 
 Roast: Medium-Light 
 
 
 Best for: Filter, pourover, AeroPress; adventurous light espresso 
 
 
 Freshness: Roasted to order. Peak from day 7–28. Reseal tight.

Name: OBSIDIAN
Tasting_Notes: Obsidian Ammikulavi
Desc:
Obsidian 
  Ammikulavi Estate • 96hr Anaerobic Canephora • Medium Light Roast  
 Some coffees impress you on the first sip. 
 Obsidian makes you question everything you thought you knew about robusta. 
 Sourced from the mist-covered hills of the Ammikulavi Estate, this 96-hour anaerobic lot is our first release in the Robusta Series. It is rich, fruit-forward, and remarkably refined, showcasing a side of robusta that most coffee drinkers never get to experience. 
 In the filter, Obsidian opens with notes of black grape, aged rum, and dried fig, wrapped in a syrupy body that lingers long after the cup is empty. As espresso, it transforms into layers of molasses, dark cacao, and burnt sugar, producing a dense crema and a deeply satisfying finish. 
 Roasted medium-light to preserve its fermentation character and natural sweetness, Obsidian delivers complexity without harshness and intensity without bitterness. 
 This is not a coffee we launched because it's different. 
 We launched it because it's genuinely delicious. 
 Filter Impression 
  Black Grape • Aged Rum • Dried Fig  
 Espresso Impression 
  Molasses • Dark Cacao • Burnt Sugar  
 Origin 
  Estate:  Ammikulavi Estate  Region:  Tamil Nadu, India  Elevation:  1300–1400 MASL  Species:  Canephora  Process:  96hr Anaerobic Fermentation  Roast Level:  Medium Light 
 Brew Guide 
  Filter • AeroPress • Clever Dripper • French Press • Espresso  
 Roaster's Note 
 For decades, robusta has been judged by its worst examples. Obsidian is what happens when the species is treated with the same care, intention, and craftsmanship as the world's finest coffees. 
 One sip is usually enough to change someone's mind. ☕️

Name: RATNAGIRI NATURAL CUT
Tasting_Notes: Fruity • Jammy • Wild Ratnagiri Natural Cut is where things get interesting
Desc:
Fruity • Jammy • Wild  
 Ratnagiri Natural Cut is where things get interesting. 
 This is coffee pushed to its expressive edge—bold fruit notes, fermented sweetness, and a heavier body that lingers long after the last sip. It’s not subtle, and it’s not trying to be. 
 Expect bursts of juicy red fruits, syrupy sweetness, and a slightly wild finish that makes every cup feel alive. This is the kind of coffee that stands out instantly—loud, complex, and unapologetically different. 
 Not for everyone. But unforgettable for the right palate. 
 
 What to Expect 
 
 Juicy, fruit-forward profile 
 Jammy sweetness with depth 
 Heavy body with lingering finish 
 Slightly funky, experimental character 
 
 
  Details 
 
 
 Origin:  Ratnagiri Estate, India 
 
 Process:  Natural 
 
 Varietal:  SLN 9 
 
 Roast Level:  Medium 
 
 Best For:  Pour Over, Aeropress, Espresso (for adventurous shots) 
 
 
 Why You’ll Love It 
 If you enjoy coffees that push boundaries and surprise you every sip—this is exactly that.

Name: RATNAGIRI WASHED CUT
Tasting_Notes: Clean • Structured • Cocoa-forward Ratnagiri Washed Cut is precision in a cup
Desc:
Clean • Structured • Cocoa-forward  
 Ratnagiri Washed Cut is precision in a cup. 
 Built for clarity and balance, this coffee highlights everything a clean process should deliver defined sweetness, controlled acidity, and a smooth, structured finish. No noise, no chaos. Just a refined expression of high-elevation Indian coffee done right. 
 Expect a cup that opens with soft cocoa and toasted sweetness, followed by a gentle brightness that keeps things lively without overpowering. The finish is clean, composed, and consistent across brews. 
 This is the kind of coffee you reach for daily but it never feels ordinary. 
 
 What to Expect 
 
 Clean, cocoa-led profile 
 Balanced sweetness with mild brightness 
 Smooth, structured finish 
 Easy to dial in across brew methods 
 
 
 Details 
 
 
 Origin:  Ratnagiri Estate, India 
 
 Process:  Washed 
 
 Varietal:  SLN 9 
 
 Roast Level:  Medium 
 
 Best For:  Espresso, Pour Over, French Press 
 
 
 Why You’ll Love It 
 If you like your coffee clean, dependable, and quietly impressive—this one delivers every single time.

Name: SUNBURST CHILL
Tasting_Notes: Blood Orange, Jasmine Tea, Honey-drizzled Pear
Desc:
Sunburst Chill  
  Chikamagalur, KA — 100% Arabica   Tasting Notes:  Blood Orange, Jasmine Tea, Honey-drizzled Pear  Process:  Washed  Elevation:  3500–5000 ft  Cold Brew Blend – Bright and Juicy  
  Description:   Sunburst Chill  is summer bottled into coffee. Crafted as a bright and lively cold brew blend, it bursts with vibrant citrus from blood orange, soft florals from jasmine tea, and a mellow sweetness of pear kissed with honey. Smooth, refreshing, and easy to sip — this one’s made for sunny days and cool moods.

Name: THE HOUSE MIX
Process: it’s a ritual. At BROOT, we craft each
Desc:
The House Mix  
  8 × 100 g | Best Sellers Selection  
 Can’t decide? That’s exactly why this exists. 
 The House Mix is a rotating selection of  eight of our best-selling coffees , chosen at random from everything we’re currently offering. It’s a snapshot of what people are actually drinking right now - blends, single origins, comfort cups, bright cups, bold cups. 
 Here’s the rule: If you buy this pack again,  none of the coffees will repeat  until you’ve worked through the full portfolio. 
 Every box is different. Every repeat order moves you forward. 
 This pack is for people who like variety, trust the roastery, and enjoy discovering new favorites without overthinking. 
  What to expect:  
 
 
 8 different coffees 
 
 
 No repeats on repeat purchases 
 
 
 Blends and single origins included 
 
 
 Profiles ranging from cozy to bright to bold 
 
 
 Always fresh, always current 
 
 
 Packed fresh in  100 g bags , ideal for tasting, sharing, gifting, or building a serious home rotation. 
 This isn’t a sampler. It’s the house showing you everything it stands for.

Name: VELVET HARMONY
Tasting_Notes: toasted nuts, soft cocoa, and a brown sugar sweetness that linge
Process: it’s a ritual. At BROOT, we craft each
Desc:
Velvet Harmony  
  Toasted Nuts • Mild Cocoa • Brown Sugar   A cozy, well-rounded blend made for your daily brew.  
 Velvet Harmony is our take on comfort in a cup. Expect a smooth, mellow profile with gentle notes of toasted nuts, soft cocoa, and a brown sugar sweetness that lingers. No sharp edges. No surprises. Just balance. 
 Perfect for espresso, pour-over, or even a classic South Indian filter. It holds up black or with milk—your call. 
  Brew it any time of day. This one’s built to stay.
